# strided-rs v0.7.0

## Breaking: placement is an explicit `Exec` token

Every entry that can fan out takes a `strided_exec::Exec` as its last parameter, by value.
The token carries the pool and a budget of slots; the callee splits it (`fork`, `for_ranges`,
`limit`) and never starts a task by any other route. No thread-local placement state exists
any more, so work that runs on a waiting thread cannot inherit another operation's pool or
budget. All workspace crates are released at 0.7.0.

- **`strided-exec` (new crate).** `Pool` and `PoolBuilder` (the only place a thread pool is
  started), `Exec` (`serial`, `new(&pool, budget)`, `budget`, `is_serial`, `reborrow`, `limit`,
  `fork`, `for_ranges`, `broadcast`, `external`), and the `Error` and `Refused` types. A token is
  neither `Clone` nor `Copy`; slots are conserved across nesting; a serial token, a budget of
  one, or a single task runs inline and never starts the process-global Rayon pool. Without the
  `parallel` feature the same types exist and every entry runs inline. No Rayon type appears in
  the public API (`scripts/check-no-public-rayon.sh`).
- **`Exec::external`.** Enters the pool once and hands the budget to an outside library (a BLAS,
  a linear-algebra backend) as a plain width.
- **One function per operation.** The `*_par` permutation copies are merged into `copy_into`,
  `copy_into_uninit` and `copy_into_col_major`. `strided-perm` uses the budget it is given and
  never chooses a width, and one `MINTHREADLENGTH` decides when a loop is worth splitting.
- **`strided-basic`, `strided-fused`, `strided-kernel`, `strided-nn`** take `Exec`;
  `strided-basic` re-exports `Exec`, `Pool` and `PoolBuilder`, and `strided-kernel` re-exports
  them from `strided-basic`. `strided-fused` and `strided-nn` use the token through
  `strided-basic`.
- **Rayon is a dependency of `strided-exec` only.** `strided-perm` and `strided-basic` no longer
  depend on it. `cargo deny check bans` rejects a direct `rayon` dependency (normal, dev or
  build) anywhere else in the workspace, and bans `faer`, `t4a-faer` and `spindle`.
- **`strided-nn` 0.7.0** (previously 0.1.1): the fused axis-0 softmax takes caller-provided
  scratch sized by executable tasks (`scratch_len`) and an `Exec`.

## Migration

| 0.6 | 0.7 |
| --- | --- |
| `ExecContext::serial()` | `Exec::serial()` |
| `ExecContext::max_threads(n)` | `Exec::new(&pool, n)?` with a `strided_exec::Pool` |
| `ExecContext::run_on(pool, ..)` | build a `Pool` once, mint `Exec::new(&pool, n)?` per call |
| `plan.execute(&ctx, ..)` (context first) | `plan.execute(.., exec)` (token last) |
| `with_execution_policy`, `ExecutionPolicy` | removed; pass an `Exec` |
| `with_execution_pool` | removed; pass an `Exec` |
| `rayon_threads()` | `exec.budget()` |
| `copy_into_par`, `copy_into_uninit_par`, `copy_into_col_major_par` | `copy_into`, `copy_into_uninit`, `copy_into_col_major` with an `Exec` |
| ambient (global Rayon pool) placement | none; use `Exec::serial()` or a pool you own |
| `StridedError::InvalidThreadBudget` | `strided_exec::Error::ZeroBudget` from `Exec::new` |
| `MaybeSend`, `MaybeSync` bounds | `Send + Sync` |
| a direct `rayon` dependency for placement | `strided-exec` (feature `parallel`, default) |

A phase sequence reuses one token with `exec.reborrow()`, because every parallel entry consumes
its token. Plans never store an `Exec`; replay takes it per call.

Design record: `docs/design/cpu-exec-placement.md`.

**Full comparison:** https://github.com/tensor4all/strided-rs/compare/v0.5.0...v0.7.0
